q-137231.name: Question 1
q-137231.problem:
What is missing from the statement below?

$$
\frac{3}{2}\times 10=3\times \bbox[2pt,border:1pt solid black]{\phantom{A}}÷\bbox[2pt,border:1pt solid black]{\phantom{A}}
$$
q-137231.worked_solution:
Interpreting the fraction as division, we can write our expression as:

$$
3÷2\times 10
$$

We can write an equivalent expression by swapping the $÷2$ and the $\times 10:$

$$
3\times 10÷2
$$
